title: Daraja Documentation
text: Shared documentation for all Daraja SDKs and the MCP server. This corpus is ingested by the MCP server for AI-assisted search.

title: Introduction
text: Daraja is the Safaricom M-Pesa developer API. This monorepo provides SDKs in three languages (Python, TypeScript, and Go) plus a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes these docs to AI coding assistants.

title: Installation
text: How to install the Daraja SDKs. Python uses pip install daraja-sdk-py, TypeScript uses npm install @daraja-sdk/ts axios, and Go uses go get github.com/yourdudeken/daraja-sdk/packages/go.

title: Configuration
text: All SDKs accept the same core options: consumerKey, consumerSecret, environment (sandbox or production), and maxRetries. Each SDK exposes an MpesaConfig-style object.

title: Authentication
text: All Daraja requests are authenticated with an OAuth2 Bearer token obtained from the OAuth endpoint using your consumer key and consumer secret. The SDKs automate this flow and refresh tokens automatically.

title: STK Push (Lipa Na M-Pesa Online)
text: Initiates a USSD prompt on the customer's phone to authorize a payment. Request fields include BusinessShortCode, Password, Timestamp, TransactionType, Amount, PartyA, PartyB, PhoneNumber, CallBackURL, AccountReference, and TransactionDesc.

title: STK Push Query
text: Checks the status of a previously initiated STK push using the CheckoutRequestID returned from the STK push initiation.

title: C2B (Customer to Business)
text: Registers a paybill URL and simulates a customer payment. Includes register URL and simulate endpoints.

title: B2C (Business to Customer)
text: Disburses funds from a business to a customer. Request fields include InitiatorName, SecurityCredential, CommandID, Amount, PartyA, PartyB, Remarks, QueueTimeOutURL, ResultURL, and Occasion.

title: B2B (Business to Business)
text: Moves funds between two business accounts (Buy Goods or Pay Bill). Request fields include Initiator, SecurityCredential, CommandID, Amount, PartyA, PartyB, AccountReference, and Remarks.

title: Account Balance
text: Queries the balance of a paybill/till account. Request fields include Initiator, SecurityCredential, CommandID, PartyA, IdentifierType, Remarks, ResultURL, and QueueTimeOutURL.

title: Transaction Status
text: Queries the status of a transaction using its original ID. Request fields include Initiator, SecurityCredential, CommandID, TransactionID, PartyA, IdentifierType, ResultURL, and QueueTimeOutURL.

title: Reversal
text: Reverses a completed M-Pesa transaction. Request fields include Initiator, SecurityCredential, CommandID, TransactionID, Amount, ReceiverParty, RecieverIdentifierType, ResultURL, and QueueTimeOutURL.

title: STK Callback
text: Safaricom POSTs result JSON to the CallBackURL after an STK push completes. The SDKs parse this into typed callback objects and verify HMAC signatures on the raw body.

title: C2B Callback
text: Safaricom POSTs confirmation/validation data to the registered URLs. The confirmation payload includes TransactionType, TransID, TransTime, TransAmount, BusinessShortCode, MSISDN, and FirstName.

title: Result Callback (B2C/B2B/Balance)
text: API requests deliver outcomes via a ResultURL callback. The payload includes ResultType, ResultCode, ResultDesc, OriginatorConversationID, ConversationID, and TransactionID.

title: Error Handling
text: Daraja returns ResponseCode/ResultCode values in responses and callbacks. A 0 means success. The SDKs map non-zero codes to typed exceptions such as AuthenticationError, RateLimitError, MpesaAPIError, TimeoutError and APIConnectionError.
